roadmap.title: Map Chamber runs for all four houses
roadmap.description: Start a fresh game for each house, keep a backup of the autosave made at the Sorting Ceremony, and play to the Map Chamber in Jackdaw's Rest. Do the full game with one of them.

roadmap.title: Main story
roadmap.description: Play the main quests through The Final Repository, learning the early spells, Ancient Magic, the Loom and gear upgrades along the way.

roadmap.title: Side quests, systems and combat tasks
roadmap.description: Finish the relationship lines, Deek's quests, flying and the Room of Requirement tasks while using Ancient Magic on each new enemy type.

roadmap.title: Collectibles and endgame
roadmap.description: Free-roam the world for Floo Flames, Merlin Trials, statues and collections, reach level 34 and 40, then win the House Cup.

achievements.displayName: The Sort Who Makes an Entrance
achievements.summary: Finish the introduction and the Sorting Ceremony.

steps.text: Play the opening story until the Sorting Ceremony ends.

achievements.description: Find the Map Chamber as a Slytherin.
achievements.summary: Find the Map Chamber while sorted into Slytherin.

guide.context: The house is fixed once you choose it, so each house needs its own game. Your answers in the ceremony do not matter, because you can pick the house yourself.

steps.text: Start a new game and choose Slytherin at the Sorting Ceremony.
Right after the sorting, copy the autosave it creates so you can reuse it for the other houses.
Play the main quests until you enter the @loc{Map Chamber} during Jackdaw's Rest.
steps.note: The achievement unlocks during that quest. A fast run takes about 1.5 to 2 hours.

achievements.description: Find the Map Chamber as a Hufflepuff.
achievements.summary: Find the Map Chamber while sorted into Hufflepuff.

guide.context: The house is fixed once you choose it, so each house needs its own game. Your answers in the ceremony do not matter, because you can pick the house yourself.

steps.text: Start a new game and choose Hufflepuff at the Sorting Ceremony.
Right after the sorting, copy the autosave it creates so you can reuse it for the other houses.
Play the main quests until you enter the @loc{Map Chamber} during Jackdaw's Rest.
steps.note: The achievement unlocks during that quest. A fast run takes about 1.5 to 2 hours.

achievements.description: Find the Map Chamber as a Gryffindor.
achievements.summary: Find the Map Chamber while sorted into Gryffindor.

guide.context: The house is fixed once you choose it, so each house needs its own game. Your answers in the ceremony do not matter, because you can pick the house yourself.

steps.text: Start a new game and choose Gryffindor at the Sorting Ceremony.
Right after the sorting, copy the autosave it creates so you can reuse it for the other houses.
Play the main quests until you enter the @loc{Map Chamber} during Jackdaw's Rest.
steps.note: The achievement unlocks during that quest. A fast run takes about 1.5 to 2 hours.

achievements.description: Find the Map Chamber as a Ravenclaw.
achievements.summary: Find the Map Chamber while sorted into Ravenclaw.

guide.context: The house is fixed once you choose it, so each house needs its own game. Your answers in the ceremony do not matter, because you can pick the house yourself.

steps.text: Start a new game and choose Ravenclaw at the Sorting Ceremony.
Right after the sorting, copy the autosave it creates so you can reuse it for the other houses.
Play the main quests until you enter the @loc{Map Chamber} during Jackdaw's Rest.
steps.note: The achievement unlocks during that quest. A fast run takes about 1.5 to 2 hours.

achievements.summary: Finish your first class.

steps.text: After the tour with @npc{Professor Wizzley}, finish either the Charms Class or the Defence Against the Dark Arts Class main quest.

achievements.summary: Survive the troll attack on Hogsmeade.

steps.text: Finish the main quest Welcome to Hogsmeade, which includes the troll fight.

achievements.description: Talk with @npc{Charles Rookwood} inside the @loc{Map Chamber}.
achievements.summary: Talk with @npc{Charles Rookwood} inside the @loc{Map Chamber}.

steps.text: Finish the main quest Percival Rackham's Trial.

achievements.summary: Rescue the phoenix.

steps.text: Open the Room of Requirement and take @npc{Deek}'s three quests in order. They are The Plight of the House-Elf, then Foal of the Dead, then Phoenix Rising.
Finish Phoenix Rising to rescue the phoenix.

achievements.description: Subdue the Lord of the Shore.
achievements.summary: Subdue the Lord of the Shore.

steps.text: Complete San Bakar's Trial, a main quest.

achievements.summary: View all Pensieve memories.

guide.context: The other memories are story objectives, so you cannot miss them.

steps.text: Complete San Bakar's Trial, a main quest. It gives the last Pensieve memory.

achievements.summary: Wield a Deathly Hallow.

steps.text: Complete Niamh Fitzgerald's Trial, a main quest.

achievements.summary: Defeat Ranrok.

steps.text: Beat @enemy{Ranrok} to end the main quest The Final Repository.

achievements.summary: Win the House Cup.

guide.context: Main-story play leaves you near level 25, so you need side content to reach level 34.

steps.text: Finish the main quest Weasley's Watchful Eye.
Reach character level 34. Do side quests and collect items until you get there.
Go to @loc{The Great Hall} in Hogwarts Castle and watch the House Cup ceremony to finish the main quest The House Cup.

achievements.summary: Finish all seven of Natsai Onai's relationship quests.

guide.context: The quests unlock as the story moves on and can be done after it. No choice can lock you out.

steps.text: Do @npc{Natsai Onai}'s quests as they appear: first The Lost Child, next A Basis for Blackmail, then Mum's the Word. Four more follow: Grief and Vengeance (fourth), Finding Focus (fifth), Harlow's Last Stand (sixth), and Acting On Instinct (last).

achievements.summary: Save a dragon.

steps.text: Finish the main quest Fire and Vice.

achievements.summary: Finish all seven of Poppy Sweeting's relationship quests.

guide.context: The quests unlock as the story moves on and can be done after it. No choice can lock you out.

steps.text: Do @npc{Poppy Sweeting}'s quests as they appear: first A Dragon Debrief, next Poached Egg, then Surprise Meeting. After those come The Centaur and the Stone (fourth), It's in the Stars (fifth), A Bird in the Hand (sixth), and Poppy Blooms (last).

achievements.summary: Finish all nine of Sebastian Sallow's relationship quests.

guide.context: The Unforgivable Curses taught in this line are not needed for any achievement.

steps.text: Do @npc{Sebastian Sallow}'s quests as they appear. All nine are named In the Shadow of: the Bloodline, the Study, Discovery, Time, Distance, Hope, the Relic, Fate, and Friendship.

achievements.description: Beat Imelda's time on all broom races.
achievements.summary: Beat Imelda's time on every broom race.

steps.text: Finish the main quest Flying Class, then the side quest Flight Test.
Buy the best broom you can afford.
Beat @npc{Imelda}'s time on all three courses: Irondale, the South Coast course, and the Hogwarts Quidditch pitch.

achievements.summary: Complete all side quests.

guide.context: There are 57 side quests in total.

steps.text: Open the quest list and finish every side quest.
Talk to the Magical Well southeast of @loc{Aranshire} to start the side quest Well, Well, Well.
Finish the side quest Follow the Butterflies before opening other butterfly chests, and do not unlock any @loc{North Ford Bog} cage before starting Take the Biscuit.

achievements.description: Complete all tiers of a challenge
achievements.summary: Complete every tier of one challenge.

guide.context: Challenges also fill the Collector's Edition collections, so this comes along with that work.

steps.text: Open the Challenges tab in the menu and finish all tiers of any one challenge.

achievements.summary: Complete every collection in the progress menu.

guide.context: The menu has ten collections: Tools (10), Enemies (69), Appearances (89), Revelio Pages (150), Beasts (13), Traits (75), Wand Handles (42), Conjurations (140), Ingredients (16), and Brooms (13).

steps.text: Open the Collection section of the progress menu to see what is missing.
Finish every challenge tier and every map. Their rewards fill most collections.
Fill the rest directly: potions, plants, beasts, enemies killed, battle arenas, and brooms.
Keep a list of the 15 butterfly chests and 12 vivarium chests. The map does not track them.

achievements.description: Use Ancient Magic for the first time.
achievements.summary: Use Ancient Magic once.

steps.text: Finish the main quest Welcome to Hogsmeade to unlock Ancient Magic.
When the blue Ancient Magic meter at the bottom right is charged, use Ancient Magic.

achievements.summary: Upgrade a piece of gear.

steps.text: Play on to the main quest titled The Elf, The Nab-Sack & the Loom. The game shows you there how to upgrade gear.

achievements.description: Stun 10 different enemies using a Mandrake
achievements.summary: Stun 10 different enemies with a Mandrake.

guide.context: The count is cumulative across fights. You can also buy Mandrakes from vendors.

steps.text: Buy a Mandrake Seed for 800 gold at Dogweed and Deathcap in north @loc{Hogsmeade}.
Plant it in a small pot, either in the Greenhouse or in the Room of Requirement. It grows in 10 minutes.
Equip the Mandrake on the item wheel and throw it at enemies until 10 have been stunned.

achievements.summary: Breed each of the 12 breedable beasts.

guide.context: The Phoenix is the 13th beast and cannot be bred, so it is not needed.

collectibles.method: Rescue one from the den, then breed it.

collectibles.location: North @loc{Hogsmeade} or west of Upper Hogsfield
collectibles.method: Start the side quest The Unique Unicorn, then rescue and breed one.
collectibles.note: The den only shows on the map after you start the quest.

achievements.summary: Brew all six types of potion.

guide.context: The Wiggenweld you make in class does not count. Any potion station works, in class or conjured.

steps.text: Unlock each recipe, then brew one of each at a potion station: Focus, Thunderbrew, Invisibility, Maxima, Endurus, and Wiggenweld.
Buy or grow the ingredients. The rest drop from spiders, Inferi, dugbogs, and mongrels.

achievements.summary: Grow each of the eight types of plant.

guide.context: Buy at least one small, one medium, and one large growing pot from Tomes and Scrolls. All shops are in @loc{Hogsmeade}. Some seeds also grow in a second pot size.

collectibles.location: Story unlock
collectibles.method: Plant it in a small pot.

collectibles.method: Plant it in a small pot.

achievements.description: Upgrade a piece of gear 3 times
achievements.summary: Upgrade one piece of gear three times.

guide.context: Green-rarity gear cannot be upgraded. Use blue, purple, or yellow gear.

steps.text: Put the Enchanted Loom down inside the Room of Requirement.
Upgrade the same piece of gear three times.

achievements.summary: Spend 5 Talent Points.

steps.text: Finish the main quest Jackdaw's Rest to unlock the talent menu.
Spend 5 points on talents.

achievements.summary: Spend every Talent Point.

guide.context: Levels 5 to 40 give 36 points in total.

steps.text: Reach level 40.
Open the talent menu and spend every remaining point.

achievements.description: Reach the highest point in the castle, the Headmaster's upper study
achievements.summary: Reach the Headmaster's upper study.

guide.context: You can also fly to the top tower balcony and cast Alohomora level 3 on the door there.

steps.text: Get Alohomora level 3. Level 1 comes from the main quest The Caretaker's Lunar Lament, and a side quest named The Man Behind the Moons upgrades it.
Finish the main quest The Polyjuice Plot, which takes you to the Headmaster's office. Afterwards go through @loc{Grand Staircase}, the Trophy Room, and the gate upstairs.
In the office, unlock the level 2 door to the balcony, then the level 3 door above it, and climb to the top of the study.

achievements.description: Use Flipendo ten times – to tip one cow or several
achievements.summary: Cast Flipendo on cows ten times.

steps.text: Learn Flipendo by completing the second assignment from @npc{Professor Garlick}.
Cast Flipendo at cows near @loc{Hogsmeade} ten times. One cow is enough.

achievements.summary: Unlock all 83 Floo Flames.

guide.context: There are 33 in Hogwarts, 3 in Hogsmeade, and 47 in the open world.

steps.text: Walk close to each Floo Flame until its map icon turns from grey to green.

achievements.summary: Follow butterflies to a treasure chest.

guide.context: There are 15 chest spots and any one gives the achievement.

steps.text: When a butterfly icon shows on the map, go to it and follow the butterflies until they circle one spot.
Cast Revelio there and open the chest.

achievements.description: Defeat enemies in all battle arenas
achievements.summary: Beat the enemy waves in both battle arenas.

guide.context: The Dark Arts arena from the paid pack does not count.

steps.text: Clear every wave in the arena at @loc{Feldcroft}.
Clear every wave in the arena at @loc{North Ford Bog}.

achievements.summary: Complete all 95 Merlin Trials.

guide.context: Trials are only in the open world. The puzzles are Accio marbles, fire pyres, boulders, platforms, Flipendo blocks, stone and pillar breaking, Reparo, and Lumos moths. The map's zoomed-out view lists trials per area.

steps.text: Find each Merlin Trial, marked with a leaf icon, and solve its puzzle.

achievements.summary: Enter all five cairn dungeons.

guide.context: Stepping inside counts. If the achievement does not unlock after the quests, check that you entered the Tomb of Treachery.

collectibles.name: Collector's Cave
collectibles.location: West of @loc{Hogsmeade}
collectibles.method: Enter it during the main quest The Helm of Urtkot.

collectibles.name: Dale Family Tomb
collectibles.location: Southeast of Hogwarts, near East @loc{Brocburrow}
collectibles.method: Enter it during the side quest Beeting' a Curse.

collectibles.name: Tomb of Treachery
collectibles.location: Behind a waterfall between @loc{Coastal Cavern} and @loc{Poidsear Coast}
collectibles.method: Enter it during the side quest Cursed Tomb Treasure.
collectibles.note: You need Alohomora level 3 to get in.

collectibles.name: Feldcroft Catacomb
collectibles.location: Southeast of @loc{Feldcroft}
collectibles.method: Enter it during Sebastian's quest In the Shadow of Time.

collectibles.name: Moonstone Garden
collectibles.location: East of the Feldcroft Catacomb
collectibles.method: Enter it during Poppy's quest The Centaur and the Stone.

achievements.summary: Visit Poidsear Coast.

steps.text: Travel to @loc{Poidsear Coast}. The story sends you there in the main quest called In the Shadow of the Mountain, but you can go earlier.

achievements.summary: Find all 33 Demiguise statues.

guide.context: One statue in the Potions Classroom needs Alohomora level 2. The hamlets with one each are Pitt-Upon-Ford, Upper Hogsfield, Lower Hogsfield, Aranshire, Brocburrow, Keenbridge, Feldcroft, Irondale, Marunweem, Bainburgh, and Cragcroft.

steps.text: Find the statues: 3 in main quests, 9 in @loc{Hogsmeade}, 10 in Hogwarts, and 11 in the hamlets.
Finish Gladwin Moon's quest chain first. It gives Alohomora level 3 and saves backtracking.

achievements.description: Defeat a total of fifty enemies using Petrificus Totalus
achievements.summary: Defeat 50 enemies with Petrificus Totalus.

steps.text: Learn Disillusionment and Petrificus Totalus by finishing the main quest named Secrets of the Restricted Section.
Cast Disillusionment, sneak up behind an enemy, and cast Petrificus Totalus when the prompt shows. Do this 50 times.

achievements.summary: Reach a combo of 100 hits.

guide.context: Getting hit resets the combo.

steps.text: Fight many enemies at once and keep hitting them without taking damage until the counter reaches 100.
Near Upper Hogsfield, a treasure vault holds Inferi that stay alive until hit with fire, so the combo can run on.

achievements.description: Use Ancient Magic on every enemy in the game
achievements.summary: Use Ancient Magic once on each of 34 enemy types.

guide.context: Only 34 of the game's 69 enemy types count, and unique and story-only enemies do not. The lists below are the types worth hitting, which covers all 34. Use the arenas to finish types you missed.

steps.text: Use Ancient Magic on every new enemy type you meet, until every type below has been hit once.
Dark wizards: Poacher Execution, Tracker, Duelist, Animagus, Ranger, Animagus (Wolf), and Stalker; Ashwind Soldier, Ranger, Executioner, Scout, Duelist, and Assassin.
Goblins: Loyalist Warrior, Ranger, Assassin, Sentinel, and Commander.
Spiders: Venomous Ambusher, Shooter, Scurrier, and Matriarch; Thornback Ambusher, Shooter, Scurrier, and Matriarch; and Acromantula.
Trolls, beasts, and undead: Forest, River, Mountain, Fighter, Armoured, and Fortified Troll; Cottograss, Great Spine, and Stoneback Dugbog; Dark Mongrel, Mongrel, and Inferius.

achievements.summary: Learn every spell except the three Unforgivable Curses.

guide.context: The three Unforgivable Curses are not needed.

steps.text: Finish the main quests and Professors' Assignments. They teach all the other spells.

achievements.summary: Reach character level 40.

guide.context: Main quests alone give about 25 levels.

steps.text: Gain XP from main quests, side quests, collectibles, and enemies until you reach level 40.
